11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11083|9dd7b921.name: Darianna
11083|9dd7b921.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.

14725|372d0086.name: Raedon Duskstriker
14725|372d0086.text:
Hail friend - a moment of your time, if I may...

We have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing Teldrassil.  Were the constant strife of the times not enough, we now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of night elves everywhere in helping us out!

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

4219|cb3f3465.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|cb3f3465.text: The blessings of Cenarius be yours, $c.  Our leader, Arch Druid Staghelm, guides us and all of Teldrassil to a renewed life!

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|f71d5637.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|f71d5637.text: The skill with which Telonis crafts armor is beyond compare.  You should be grateful that he does not charge more for the knowledge he passes to others.  Go now and seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace in the northeast section of Darnassus.

4753|b87a8862.name: Jartsam
4753|b87a8862.text: I can teach you the finer points of Tiger Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

5157|7805515d.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|7805515d.text: Great, let's get started... ha! Fooled you! Surely you didn't think it would be that simple. You'll need to prove your mettle just like everyone else!

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|ec597f71.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ec597f71.text: Ah, I believe Gimble Thistlefuzz is who ye'll be needing if yer looking to learn the Enchanter's profession.  Ye'll find Gimble in his shop, Thistlefuzz Arcanery, right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?
